cohort.selection: Reuse exact R05 IDs, split roles and grouping

budget: All 30 epochs run; 480 updates per fit; no early stopping
selection: Earliest strictly lowest validation MAE among epochs 1-30; epoch zero excluded
control_requirement: Every fresh Smooth L1 fit must exactly reproduce the matched frozen R05 original-decay state, history, gradients, predictions and metrics
primary_comparison: Within model and seed: MAE-loss validation MAE minus Smooth-L1-loss validation MAE

full_training_decision.rule: One common loss for both models: mean of all six selected-checkpoint validation MAEs per loss; choose MAE only if its mean is more than 1e-12 lower, otherwise retain Smooth L1
full_training_decision.next_stage: Full eligible development cohort, not all raw CVEs
full_training_decision.initialization: Fresh fixed-seed initialization; no R05 or R06 checkpoint warm start
full_training_decision.checkpoint_selection: Earliest strictly best validation MAE, epochs 1 onward; persistence reported separately
full_training_decision.gate: Complete verified comparison, finite outputs and exact R05 control parity; repair technical failures without changing the scientific protocol
full_training_decision.baseline_policy: Proceed to full development training with the chosen loss, but do not claim a learned-model win unless it beats the reference on the stated metric

limitations: Validation has informed earlier development decisions; this is not an independent final evaluation
The fixed small cohort is dominated by unchanged EPSS endpoints
A lower average selects a development setting, not statistical significance or a deployment model
Current descriptions remain retrospective rather than authenticated historical Day-30 inputs
Loss magnitude cannot be compared directly between MAE and Smooth L1
Full training remains a separate user-run stage after verification; no more bounded loss/decay tuning is planned
